state_free_control.weighting: equal independent validation cases within each regime
state_free_control.count_measure: requested integer count at each response, including horizon-truncated responses
state_free_control.rng_algorithm: python.random.Random per case, SHA-256-derived dedicated seed; never shares environment or optimizer RNG

control.weighting: equal independent validation cases within each regime
control.count_measure: requested integer count at each response, including horizon-truncated responses
control.rng_algorithm: python.random.Random per case, SHA-256-derived dedicated seed; never shares environment or optimizer RNG

selection.interpretation: Control removes current-state association and changes temporal dependence; regime identity remains available.

uncertainty.method: paired percentile bootstrap within regime, equal 1/4 regime weights; independent cases are resampling units
uncertainty.standard_error: sqrt(sum(sample variance of paired differences in each regime / regime case count)) / 4

saved_measurements: Every compressed case includes per-environment error, recovery traces, swarm count, query accounting and full observed response state.
